test_title: PYST 146: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 01 Feb, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six family members Viraaj, Deepu, Noor, Prince, Suman and Taran are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Viraaj is sitting to the immediate right of Noor. Prince is an immediate neighbour of both Viraaj and Deepu. Suman is sitting third to the right of Viraaj. Noor is sitting second to the left of Prince. Who is the immediate neighbour of Deepu and Viraaj?
solution:
**Given : **Six family members Viraaj, Deepu, Noor, Prince, Suman and Taran are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

**Explanation : **

1) Viraaj is sitting to the immediate right of Noor.

2) Prince is an immediate neighbour of both Viraaj and Deepu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b6a56b6756be06a2f94c275761f800cdd9b957d9fb6a288252081a820d6b1b0.png] 

3) Suman is sitting third to the right of Viraaj.

4) Noor is sitting second to the left of Prince.

After positioning Suman only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Taran.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dca607e507ad9e2fbb7c3bac93cca37c4c2c79949fcdc41995bf3ec822504a2.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Prince is an immediate neighbour of Deepu and Viraaj.

Hence, **"Prince"** is the correct answer.
